title: A home for the platform, in any form factor.

forms.title: Custom-built
forms.body: Veranda designs and builds a receptacle around your requirements, with our hardware and sensors integrated from the start.

forms.title: Off-the-shelf
forms.body: Our hardware and software can be integrated into standard coolers, boxes, and lockers. This is the approach we use for field trials.

forms.title: Your own product
forms.body: Veranda can be built into a product you already make or sell, adding secure access and monitoring to a form factor your customers already know.

showcase.title: Built around the job, and the budget
showcase.body: Each custom receptacle is designed around how it will be used and what it needs to cost, from simple, low-cost housings to fully insulated boxes for temperature-sensitive goods. The DreamBox is one example: an insulated cooler with a smart lock and sensors built in. Whichever you choose, our hardware and software are purpose-built to integrate into a variety of form factors.
